facts.fact: 闪婚过教堂：神父坚持结婚预告要宣三次，Perla 其实怕白纱婚礼招笑话。
facts.anchor: Father Anselmo had been aghast when Perla and Ulises showed up at the church.

facts.fact: Ulises 谎称 Las Tunas 法官已公证（实未），神父被吓得破例主婚——教区关卡被一张嘴绕过。
facts.anchor: Ulises told Father Anselmo that the judge in Las Tunas had already married them in a civil ceremony and they could dispense with the religious one if the priest wouldn’t marry them.

facts.fact: 全镇话题对比：上一次是二十年前妹妹私奔，这次是惊叹加一点嫉妒——新郎帅。
facts.anchor: The last time people had talked so ceaselessly about Perla had been more than twenty years before, when Encarnación ran away.

facts.fact: 婚宴的浅紫礼服是 Inés 不眠不休赶制的；Perla 的婚礼全程压榨侄女手艺。
facts.anchor: Inés had labored, sleeplessly, over the sewing machine and produced a chic, pale lavender dress that suited Perla much more than the mandatory bridal white of an ordinary wedding.

facts.fact: Cándido 的收账机器：法律术语+枕头下手枪；Perla 的「信用」生意真相。
facts.anchor: the memory of the pistol he kept under his pillow served to facilitate their cooperation.

facts.fact: 婚后：分房惯例照旧（他睡原房间），夜里溜进她被窝；镇上称她「Inclán Arnao de Linares 夫人」，非正式称呼一概不收。
facts.anchor: Her nights were the element that changed.

facts.fact: 广场财政战：他要加名到银行账户、要卖「存放在城里的器材」、要开影楼——她一句「去找份工作」顶回，还点名「别想动我的钱」。
facts.anchor: “Perla, a wife can’t make all the decisions in a marriage.

facts.fact: 闪回：父亲中风、母亲靠鸦片酊度日、战后全家挂牌开客栈（「睁眼看看，多少人家在自家开店」）。
facts.anchor: Her father has a stroke a month after Encarnación runs away.

facts.fact: 父亲当着 Cándido 宣告：死前女儿嫁人＝剥夺继承权——锁死 Perla 婚事也吓退求婚者；从此她困守客栈。
facts.anchor: “Whatever money I have, and the house, will not go to my daughter until I am dead.

facts.fact: 章末：Encarnación 拎行李箱回来，裙摆后躲着黑卷发小女孩（Inés）——全书最重要的一次不速之客。
facts.anchor: She snaps her eyes open and stares at her sister, who stands in front of her holding a suitcase in one hand.
